title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Member Terms — Schedule of Finch Note Values and Limits
content:
Finch Notes are the reward certificates of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program. This schedule states, for each tier, how many points make one note, what a note is worth, how soon it is issued, how long it stays valid, how many can be applied to one purchase, and the terms on which a note is used.

## Note terms by tier

| Tier | Points per note | Note value (USD) | Note validity (calendar days) | Notes per purchase transaction (maximum) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 1000 | 10.00 | 60 | 5 |
| Finch Circle Silver | 1000 | 10.00 | 60 | 5 |
| Finch Circle Gold | 1000 | 10.00 | 90 | 5 |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 1000 | 10.00 | 90 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 1000 | 10.00 | 120 | 10 |
| Finch Circle Icon | 1000 | 10.00 | 180 | 10 |

## Terms common to every tier

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Note issue time | within 2 business days after the points balance reaches the points per note |
| Purchase types a note cannot be applied to | gift cards, alteration fees, delivery fees, shipping fees, sales tax |
| Cash value or change | none — a note cannot be exchanged for cash and gives no change |
| Single use | yes — a note is consumed whole in one transaction and any unused value is forfeited |

## Definitions

- **Points per note** — the points converted into one Finch Note, in whole points.
- **Note value** — the value of one Finch Note issued from points, USD to 2 decimals.
- **Note issue time** — the business days after the points balance reaches the points per note within which the note is issued.
- **Note validity** — the calendar days a points-conversion or birthday Finch Note stays valid, counting the issue date as day 1.
- **Notes per purchase transaction** — the maximum number of Finch Notes that can be applied to one purchase transaction.
- **Redemption exclusions** — the purchase types toward which Finch Notes cannot be applied.
- **Cash value** — whether a Finch Note can be exchanged for cash or give change (it cannot).
- **Single use** — whether a Finch Note is consumed whole in one transaction, any unused value being forfeited (it is).

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Finch Circle Gold note issued on 1 March is valid for 90 days with 1 March as day 1; its last valid day is 29 May.
- A Finch Circle Icon member may apply up to 10 notes to one purchase transaction; a Finch Circle Silver member up to 5.
- A 10.00 note applied to an eligible amount of 6.00 is consumed whole; the remaining 4.00 is forfeited and no change is given.
